purpose: One explicit fail-closed admission boundary between real content identities (M12/M13/M14) and the existing M10/M11 reference sandbox/planner: 'may this concrete real content skill become an action candidate for the reference battle planner?'. Every current 4.4.54 real skill is answered NO, typed, deterministically, preflight-only and state/RNG/allocator neutral.

modules.models.py: typed request, closed outcome/reason vocabulary, result and non-effect record
modules.admission.py: M14-backed admission and the optional planner facade

outcome_vocabulary.note: No executable success exists because no current runtime authority can produce one. A future positive admission must arrive with a real runtime execution authority, not by widening this enum alone.

reason_vocabulary.unmapped_policy: An M14 reason this build does not recognise is surfaced as UNMAPPED_M14_REASON with the raw M14 code preserved; it is never silently mapped onto a known reason.

result_model.frontier_packet_field_policy: The field name (e.g. SPHitRatio) is carried as a name for routing only. No value, formula, recipient or mutation class is ever derived from it.

hard_pre_planner_boundary.invariant: A rejected real-content admission occurs before, and never creates, any of the artifacts below.
hard_pre_planner_boundary.enforcement: Structural, not a runtime check: the boundary imports none of those types and accepts no mutable battle state, so it has no mechanism to produce them.

purity_design.design_note: The stronger design is used: because admission accepts no BattleState at all, state neutrality is structural rather than something that must be re-verified per call. An integration test additionally proves that calling admission leaves an existing M10 session snapshot byte-identical.

no_content_to_m10_conversion.note: There is currently no authorized content execution bridge.

m10_m11_compatibility.m10_synthetic_path: unchanged; explicitly scoped, own reference envelopes
m10_m11_compatibility.m11_planner_path: unchanged; plans over M10 local sessions

planner_facade.on_rejection: returns the structured rejection and stops
planner_facade.on_non_rejected: raises PositiveContentAdmissionNotImplementedError (reason code POSITIVE_CONTENT_ADMISSION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED); the facade never enters a planner under any branch
proved_by: patched M11 search_battle_plans with zero invocations
monkeypatched non-rejected admission stub still raises and never plans
source scan asserting no positive planner handoff exists

positive_admission_requires_all_of: content capability/identity (M13/M14 record exists and is represented)
authorized content binder (content -> reference settlement, does not exist yet)
runtime evidence/readiness (evidence mode and readiness satisfied at runtime)
GateCertificate / preflight closure from the strict execution path
future_extension_boundary.note: A cleaner M13/M14 status must never by itself make content executable; positive admission can only be introduced alongside a separate runtime execution authority that can supply the existing strict execution prerequisites.

runtime_authority_boundary.invariant: Registry-derived capability data NEVER satisfies GateCertificate or NATIVE_EVIDENCED.
